name: promote-skills
description: Detect repeated ad-hoc workflows in the activity ledger and draft skill candidates for owner review. Use when the owner says "check for skill candidates", "promote skills", "find new skills", or "/promote-skills". Reads dean/.activity.jsonl, clusters repeated workflows, drafts SKILL.md candidates to dean/skill-candidates/. Manual-run only in v3.1 - do not create a scheduled task for this skill.
